summary: A welded steel prison double bunk: four square posts bolted to the floor through flanges, two solid steel bed… options mattress, frame, bedding; sockets socket_bunk_lower, socket_bunk_upper, seat_lower.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.prison_bunk_steel or place "prefab": "prison_bunk_steel" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
